text: ひとの　マネ　すんなって？

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な after a plain verb is a rough 'don't'; すんな is a slurred spoken form of するな. すんな = 'don't do it'.

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って after words repeats back what someone said, like 'you say'. すんなって = 'don't do it, you say?'.
